messages.subject: Quizzlets on single page
parts:
Hi Phil,

Thank you for developing mirtCAT.

I was wondering if it is possible to have multiple questions from a quizzlets in one single page, so before clicking next.
I realized it is possible to put the together as a sequence, but I was wondering if they could also be in the same page.

Thank you,
Ricardo Ruiz

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Quizzlets on single page
parts:
It is possible to set something like this up, but I generally dislike the idea of scrolling down in an interface like mirtCAT since the 'Next' button remains fixed in the top left panel. I'd recommend doing something like adding a 'tab' interface for users to answer through in the same item and collect the information that way. Though in general I still believe presenting one item at at time makes the most sense, and forcing the interface to always administer the items in sequence when necessary. 

Phil
